title: USS John F. Kennedy orb and systems failure
place_text: USS John F. Kennedy at sea

tellings.quote: says. July 2nd, 1971. It's 8:30 at night. He's running the comms [clears throat and cough] and he said all the in inbound communication starts spouting gibberish.

plain: On 2 July 1971, at 8:30 at night aboard the US aircraft carrier John F. Kennedy at sea, every incoming communication suddenly turned to gibberish, in a story about a glowing orb and the ship's systems failing. The researcher Richard Dolan passes this on from a man named James Kopp, who says he was running communications that night, and whose account Dolan ties to the Disclosure Project, an effort that collected testimony from former military witnesses. If it is true, something near the ship was able to knock out a warship's communications.
